name: Lemon-Dijon Chicken Wings with Bacon, Blue Cheese & Spinach Salad

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 245°C (475°F). Line two baking sheet pans with aluminum foil to make clean up easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
3 medium carrots
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Zest lemons into a large bowl, then add oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the marinade. (Set lemons aside for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tbsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat chicken wings dry with paper towels and add to the bowl with the marinade; toss to coat. Divide between the baking sheets and spread out in a single layer.
instructions.secondary_message: 1.36 kg chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.primary_message: Place wings in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning once, until cooked through, 25-30 minutes. Remove from oven.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 5-6 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove crispy bacon to a paper towel-lined plate.
While the bacon is cooking, juice reserved lemons into a clean large bowl; add Dijon, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the bacon is done, add drippings from the skillet to the bowl with the lemon juice and Dijon; whisk to combine the dressing.
Using a clean cutting board, peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and medium dice cucumbers; add to the bowl and set aside.
Right before serving, add crispy bacon, spinach, and blue cheese to the bowl with the dressing and veggies; toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide wings and salad between plates. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: chicken wings, split with tips removed
